name: Tathawade
civicNote: Brought into PCMC from gram panchayat in 1997.
summary: A growing suburb in Pimpri-Chinchwad, north of Hinjewadi and near Wakad. It has grown largely because it is close to the Hinjewadi IT park.
knownFor: Several college campuses, including JSPM and Indira College
Residential growth driven by nearness to Hinjewadi IT park
connectivity: Mumbai-Bengaluru highway runs alongside the area
Close to the Hinjewadi IT park and the Mumbai-Pune Expressway
suits: IT professionals and students who want to live near Hinjewadi and Wakad.
